seed_selection: Six unique system-random uint32 values excluded from recognized public/local non-private metadata; two development and four future reserved roles, no evaluation outcomes used for selection.
purpose: Collect and seal a bounded set of validated conditional teacher selections from fresh official development games, without training.
panel: Two development seeds, frozen round2 and market opponents, both seats: eight teacher-task games, eight primary replays, one fixed separate-process replay.
sampling: Validate every callback; retain every DIG/FERTILIZE teacher choice and hash-sample other choices at 12.5 percent; report full-stream and retained counts separately.
coverage: At least 256 retained groups, 32 per development seed, 3 selected operations, DIG>=32, FERTILIZE>=100 and each development seed contributes at least one DIG. Counts do not establish diversity, task completion or competitive strength.
resources: Registered official/data Jobs, three 4GiB host-memory samples before each Job and 2GiB sampled floor; frozen byte, candidate, callback, archive and time budgets. Sampling is not a hard system memory bound.
stopping: Any identity, resource, official execution, replay, source, cleanup, sample or receipt failure stops without retry, replacement or extra games; insufficient coverage produces no trainable seal.
boundaries: No fit, GPU training, PPO, policy/default Bot/official rules changes or online submission. Replays, traces, observations and arrays stay private; reserved seeds are not used.
provenance: Independent subagent advice and review, not WebChat.
